paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: 1 of 2 plots in figure. This plot is at the bottom of the plot pair

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the changes in "Initial Accuracy" and "Final Accuracy" concerning "o_pop frequency" over a specified range. The x-axis is labeled "o_pop frequency (x10^4)" and follows a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 19 with tick labels at intervals of 2 units. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy", also using a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2 units. The green line represents "Initial Accuracy", marked with square markers and a solid line style. It starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.35 at an x-axis value of 1, shows slight fluctuations, peaking around 0.55 at x = 13, and ends around 0.4 at x = 19. The blue line represents "Final Accuracy", marked with circular markers and a dashed line style. This line begins at a value slightly above 0.6 at x = 1, shows intermittent peaks and troughs, with a notable peak near 0.9 at x = 13, and concludes at around 0.9 at x = 19. At each tick marker, there are error bars indicating variability or uncertainty. These error bars have low variability for initial x-values but become significantly large after x=9. There is a legend box available on top of the plot to infer the lines to their labels.
